nodes.title: 剧本变量
widgets_values:
【题材】：末世科幻 / 丧尸危机
【画风】：写实电影感
【时长】：20s
【角色档案】：
角色A
角色B
【分镜脚本】（共9个镜头，按从左到右、从上到下顺序）：
双胞胎大战丧失

properties.text: 只需要上传九宫格 简单描述 直接运行  即可

widgets_values:
[0.00-2.50] FPV shot, immersive first-person perspective, dynamic tracking shot, violent camera shake, intense action blur, high-speed cinematic movement, a twin-tailed girl in a dirty white crop top operating a massive rotary minigun, firing furiously, teeth grit, eyes wide with intense adrenaline, yelling with mouth wide open, screaming in fury, realistic face muscles moving, no smiling, blinding muzzle flashes, flying brass casings, smoke, dust, ruined city background, Subtitle: "去死吧，你们这群怪物！"

[2.50-5.00] Low-angle tracking shot, dynamic tactical action, two twin-tailed girls standing back-to-back in a ruined street, one in a white crop top and one in a floral dress, firing AK-47 assault rifles at a swarming zombie horde, grim determination, teeth grit, eyes wide with intense adrenaline, no smiling, sparks, muzzle flashes, dark apocalyptic ruins, volumetric smoke, Subtitle: "帮我盯着后面！"

[5.00-8.00] FPV shot, high-speed cinematic movement, violent camera shake, a twin-tailed girl on a vehicle-mounted turret firing a minigun while her partner in a floral dress fires an assault rifle from the ground, screaming in fury, terrified yet resolute expression, eyes wide with intense adrenaline, realistic face muscles moving, no smiling, explosions in the background, flying debris, high-impact framing, Subtitle: "它们根本杀不完！"

[8.00-10.00] Close-up shot, slow push-in, handheld camera shake, twin-tailed girl in a dirty white crop top looking directly into the camera, terrified yet resolute expression, heavy breathing, sweat and dirt on her face, realistic face muscles moving, grim determination, no smiling, burning ruins behind her, embers floating in the air, dramatic chiaroscuro lighting, Subtitle: "我们不能在这里停下……"

[10.00-12.00] Close-up shot, slow tracking shot, twin-tailed girl in a floral dress holding her assault rifle close, looking forward with focused eyes, grim determination, teeth grit, realistic face muscles moving, no smiling, smoldering ash, golden hour backlight, soft volumetric lighting, cinematic depth of field, Subtitle: "我陪你战到最后。"

[12.00-14.50] FPV shot, dynamic tracking shot, intense action blur, violent camera shake, both twin-tailed girls running at high speed through a ruined street, dodging debris and reaching zombie hands, terrified yet resolute expression, heavy breathing, screaming in fury, no smiling, crumbling buildings, dust clouds, high-impact action framing, Subtitle: "快跑！别回头！"

[14.50-18.00] High-angle cinematic shot, slow zoom-out, wide shot from behind the two girls as they defend a fortified barricade with a mounted minigun, overlooking a burning, destroyed city at night, searchlights cutting through the dark sky, tracer rounds flying, fires burning across the ruined cityscape, dramatic volumetric lighting, Subtitle: "这是我们最后的防线了。"

[18.00-20.50] Low-angle shot, fast panning shot, dynamic tactical action, both girls in low combat crouches, one firing a submachine gun while the other quickly reloads her rifle, teeth grit, eyes wide with intense adrenaline, grim determination, no smiling, gun smoke, flying sparks, debris, dramatic side lighting, Subtitle: "我换弹匣！掩护我！"

[20.50-25.00] Static cinematic shot, slow push-in, both twin-tailed girls standing side-by-side amidst the smoking ruins, holding their weapons, looking at the camera, exhausted but resolute expression, subtle chest movement from heavy breathing, realistic face muscles, no smiling, golden hour backlight, beautiful sunset sky with dramatic clouds, smoke rising from the ruined city, cinematic masterpiece, Subtitle: "我们活下来了……"
